lines.l: We'll be right back.
Once I rose above the noise and confusion
Just to get a glimpse beyond this illusion
I was soaring ever higher
But I flew too high
Though my eyes could see I still was a blind man
Though my mind could think I still was a mad man
I hear the voices when I'm dreaming
I can hear them say
Carry on our wayward son
There'll be peace when you are done
But your weary head to rest
Don't you cry no more
Masquerading as a man with no reason
My charade is the event of the season
And if I claim to be a wise man
Well, it's shown to me that I don't know
On the stormy sea of moving emotion
Tossed about them like a ship on the ocean
A set of course for winter fortune
But I hear the voices say
Carry on the layward sun
There'll be peace when you walk down
Take your weary head to rest
Don't you cry no more
We'll be right back.
We'll be right back.
Carry on my wayward sound
There'll be peace when you are done
And you'll hear me have to rest
Don't you cry
Don't you cry no more
